title: User Mentions/Tagging
content: Build @mention system for tagging users. Trigger: typing @ shows autocomplete dropdown. Dropdown: user avatar, name, username, follows you badge. Search: filters as user types. Selection: click or arrow keys + enter. Display: mention styled differently in text (text-blue-600). Limit: max mentions per post. Notification: tagged users receive notification.

variants.simple: Create @mention autocomplete for tagging users in posts.
variants.detailed: Build @mention system for tagging users. Trigger: typing @ shows autocomplete dropdown. Dropdown: user avatar, name, username, follows you badge. Search: filters as user types. Selection: click or arrow keys + enter. Display: mention styled differently in text (text-blue-600). Limit: max mentions per post. Notification: tagged users receive notification.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive @mention system for user tagging. Trigger detection: listen for @ symbol in input/textarea, track cursor position to detect mention context, support @ at start of input or after space. Autocomplete dropdown: positioned below cursor (calculate position from caret), max-h-64 overflow-y-auto, bg-white rounded-lg shadow-xl border. Loading state while fetching. Empty state if no matches. Results: list of matching users ordered by relevance (friends first, then followers, then others). User row: flex items-center gap-3 p-2 hover:bg-gray-50, avatar (w-8 h-8 rounded-full), name (font-medium), username (text-gray-500 @handle), badges ("Follows you", "Mutual", verified check). Navigation: arrow keys move selection highlight, enter/tab confirms selection, escape closes. Search behavior: debounced API call as user types after @, search by name and username, fuzzy matching. Mention insertion: on selection, replace @partial with @username, add space after, store mention data (user ID, display text) in state. Styled display: mentions render as inline span with different styling (text-blue-600 bg-blue-50 rounded px-0.5) or as chips. Editing: clicking mention selects whole mention, backspace removes entire mention. Mention limits: max mentions per post (e.g., 10), show count "5/10 mentions". Backend data: submit post with mention user IDs for notification system. Notifications: tagged users receive notification "X mentioned you in a post" with link. Privacy: respect user settings (some users may have mentions disabled). Mobile: dropdown as bottom sheet on small screens, larger touch targets. Contenteditable: if using contenteditable for rich text, handle mention nodes properly. Accessibility: dropdown is combobox role, announce selected item, keyboard fully operable. Performance: virtualize long user lists, cache recent mentions.
